idea-plugin.name: Commit Messages for Claude Code
idea-plugin.description:
Writes Conventional Commits messages that read like your team wrote them, from exactly the changes you are committing, with your local Claude Code CLI and your Claude subscription. No API key.

Why this plugin

  • Watch it write. The message appears in the commit field as Claude writes it, with a live timer, so you are never staring at an empty box.
  • Matches your repository's style. It follows the scopes, capitalization and ticket format of your recent commits, and picks up ticket IDs such as ABC-123 from the branch name.
  • Only what you commit. Uses just the checked files, honors partial commits (excluded hunks stay out) and includes new unversioned files. Generated folders, lock files and minified bundles are listed by name only, so they don't drown out the real change.
  • One click for another option. Not happy with the message? Retry in the notification asks Claude for a different one.
  • Light on your subscription. Fast mode sends only the commit rules instead of Claude Code's full system prompt and skips MCP servers, using far fewer tokens with the same model.
  • Private by design. No telemetry. Claude runs with all tools disabled, so it can't read other files or run commands; it only sees what the plugin sends (the diff, the branch name and recent commit titles). See the privacy policy.

How it works

  1. Check the files you want to commit.
  2. Click Generate Commit Message with Claude next to Amend in the commit panel.
  3. Review the message (the notification shows the detected type, such as feat or fix, and why) and commit.

Settings

Settings → Tools → Commit Messages for Claude Code: model (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Fable or any custom model), effort, path to the claude CLI, message language (same as the IDE by default), always include a scope, match recent commits, your own extra instructions, fast mode, timeout, and whether to replace an existing message without asking. The plugin's own UI is available in English and Spanish.

Requirements

The claude CLI installed and logged in with your Claude subscription. macOS or Linux; Windows support is experimental. Works in IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, Rider, Android Studio, DataGrip and other JetBrains IDEs, 2025.2 or later.

Not affiliated with Anthropic.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.12.1

  • Fable added to the model list. Each option is a Claude Code alias that always uses the latest model of its family.

1.12.0

  • Custom model: type any model name or alias accepted by claude --model.
  • Effort setting (--effort, Low to Max): lower effort answers a little sooner.
  • Claude CLI path setting, for installations the plugin cannot find automatically.
  • Clear message when your Claude Code version does not support an option, naming the option.

1.11.1

  • Clearer plugin description.

1.11.0

  • Fast mode streams the reply: the commit message appears in the field as Claude writes it.
  • Generated files (build, dist, bin, node_modules…), lock files and minified bundles are listed by name only, so the diff sent to Claude is smaller and the message focuses on the real changes.

1.10.1

  • The button spinner no longer looks frozen, and the message field and progress bar show the elapsed seconds while Claude works.

1.10.0

  • New "Fast mode" setting (on by default): only the commit rules are sent as the system prompt and MCP servers are skipped, using far fewer tokens with the same model and rules. Falls back to the normal command on older Claude Code versions.
  • In fast mode, the commit section of the project's CLAUDE.md (if any) is added to the rules.

1.9.1

  • No longer uses internal IntelliJ Platform APIs (commit workflow, list renderer, message bundle), for better compatibility with future IDE versions.

1.9.0

  • Progress feedback while Claude works: the message field shows "Claude is generating the commit message…" and the button shows a spinner.

1.8.0

  • Retry button in the notification: asks Claude for a different message (or repeats the request after an error).
  • New setting "Additional instructions": your own rules added to the prompt, e.g. "Explain why in the body".

1.7.0

  • Experimental Windows support: finds claude.exe or npm's claude.cmd in PATH and the default install locations.
  • Clear error message when the Claude CLI cannot be started; Linux falls back to bash or sh when $SHELL is not set.

1.6.0

  • New setting "Always include a scope": titles always get a scope such as feat(settings): …, even if recent commits do not use one.

1.5.0

  • New default message language: "Same as IDE". Commit messages follow the IDE language unless you pick a fixed language in settings.

1.4.0

  • The plugin UI follows the IDE language: English, or Spanish when the IDE runs with a Spanish language pack.

1.3.0

  • The whole plugin is now in English: button, settings, notifications and dialogs.
  • Commit messages are written in English by default. Choose another language in settings; previously chosen languages are kept.

1.2.0

  • Matches your repository's style: the titles of the last 20 commits are sent as a reference (scopes, capitalization, ticket IDs). Can be turned off in settings.
  • Projects without Git installed no longer fail when reading the branch name.

1.1.5

  • With "overwrite without asking" enabled, the current message is cleared as soon as you click the button and restored if generation fails or is cancelled.

1.1.4

  • Renamed from "Claude Commit" to "Commit Messages for Claude Code".

1.1.3

  • Clear message when the Claude Code CLI is not logged in or the session has expired.

1.1.2

  • Fixed model selection with zsh.
  • Cancel and timeout now work with large diffs; UTF-8 everywhere.
  • Faster, more stable responses: no tools, no saved sessions, runs outside the project.
  • Warns when no file is checked instead of using the whole changelist.

1.1.0

  • Settings page: model, language, timeout, overwrite confirmation.
  • Unversioned files and partial commits are included; works with any VCS.
  • Saves open editors before building the diff; button disabled while running.
  • New plugin and button icons; compatible with 2025.2 – 2026.3.
